title: Hearty Smoked American Pork Skewers
description: A rich and savory dish featuring smoked pork, grapefruit juice, and a hint of ayurvedic tamasic-friendly spices, perfect for a comforting dinner. The score-fat adds a creamy and indulgent touch to the skewers.
instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together grapefruit juice, score-fat, smoked paprika, brown sugar, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Add the pork cubes to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated pork cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the robata-grill and cook for 20 minutes, turning occasionally.
After 20 minutes, reduce the heat to 300 degrees Fahrenheit and continue cooking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
